helpful: The sal-v4 segment base rate table with bracketed reached rates gave a clean, leakage-safe anchor for the baseline band.
The provisioned petition text let me read the posture (untimely state appeal, pro se, no split) directly rather than inferring from the docket.
gaps: No statpack cut for pro se versus counseled paid petitions, or for respondent-waived petitions; both are the features that moved this cell off the anchor and I had to weight them from general knowledge.
fedcourts query ranks by recency and has no filter for originating state court, petitioner type, or waiver status, so a similar-priors pull for a state-court pro se petition is not really possible.
notes: Clean cell: snapshot, context, petition and QP all present and consistent; no BIO because respondents waived. Did not need the CourtListener MCP server.
